summary: Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Securities Inc., as depositor for CD 2017-CD3 Mortgage Trust, filed an 8-K reporting that effective October 14, 2026, the directing holder under the COMM 2015-CCRE26 PSA terminated CWCapital Asset Management LLC as special servicer and appointed Torchlight Loan Services, LLC as successor special servicer. The affected asset is the Prudential Plaza mortgage loan, held in the issuing entity but serviced under a separate 2015 trust agreement. No financial terms, prices, or board recommendations were disclosed. The change transfers special servicing duties for a single loan, with CWCapital replaced by Torchlight after the directing holder exercised its contractual removal right.
